items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I know Roy Haynes became a whiskey salesman.

ctx.x: the Post Office at one time.

Oh, I know, J.J. Johnson was...I think he's still in the Post Office out on the coast. Sure. I know Roy Haynes became a whiskey salesman. You know, you try to think about different things. Try to survive, that's the whole thing. You see what I mean. Tryin' to make it, see. But I didn't do anything, say "I'm gonna try to make it some kinda way." Of course I was learning all the time, you know, about all facets of the business, you know what I mean. So all these things that you learn, you know, you put 'em in the…
So, in Virginia you did eventually take a job as a musical consultant...
